xBRIEFInfo.description: Phase 1 product-signal on-ramp under epic #2603 — design-locked scope for consented agent-driven check-in + private GitHub sink adapter

plan.title: Consented agent-driven product signal (private deftai sink, defaults off)

narratives.Overview: Ship a consented, agent-driven product-improvement signal path. The agent interviews lightly, attaches machine context (platform × harness × directive) plus minimized summaries of existing local ledgers (#1709 value/attribution, #1703 eval:health, #2545 helped/health) and optional #829 skillsSummary, then submits via private `deftai/product-signal` through a thin transport adapter. Defaults OFF; no ambient consent nag; soft-skip when not enabled / not consented / unauthorized. Sibling to #1709 gap escalation — does not replace it. Parent epic #2603 owns batched Insights/warehouse/dashboard; #2697 owns Phase 2 HTTP transport.
narratives.Origin: Ingested and design-locked from https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/2693 (triage accept f8c31a48-3356-4f9d-a0ec-9754c9adf986). Amendment comments on the issue are superseded by LockedDecisions below after operator confirm.
narratives.Problem: Close partners and trial teams lack a low-friction in-product pulse. `feedback:file` / deft-directive-feedback is confirmation-heavy gap escalation into public deftai/directive — wrong sink and UX for NPS / liked-disliked-missed pulses. Humans should not assemble env dumps.
narratives.LockedDecisions:
## Design lock — pass-1 (2026-07-21)

Operator: Scott. Scope: #2693 only. Aligns with #2603 principles (local-first, consent-tiered, minimization, soft-fail, human gate for public issues) without delivering warehouse/dashboard.

### D1. Sibling surface — not overload of #1709

**Decided:** New `plan.policy.productSignal` typed policy block + new skill `deft-directive-product-signal` + CLI verbs under `task product-signal:*`. Reuse `feedback:file` / gh-rest plumbing for issue create/comment only; do **not** extend `valueFeedback.upstreamPrompt` into a survey tool.

**Why:** #2603 already names `productInsights` / product signal as separate from `valueFeedback`. Gap escalation stays confirmation-gated to public `deftai/directive`; pulses must not spam that repo.

**Rejected:** Folding pulses into `feedback:file`; reusing only `valueFeedback.enabled` as the outbound gate.

### D2. Dual gate: enable × consent

**Decided:** Outbound requires **both**:
1. **Enable** — `plan.policy.productSignal.enabled === true` (project/install typed policy; default `false`). Capability-cost disclosure on enable (mirror `policy:enable-value-feedback`).
2. **Consent** — recorded user consent at install/user scope (platform-config path adjacent to USER.md: win32 `%APPDATA%\deft\product-signal-consent.json`, unix `~/.config/deft/product-signal-consent.json`). Shape: `{ consentVersion, grantedAt, tier, revokedAt? }`.

Consent map to #2603 tiers for Phase 1: only `Insights-linked` (or a Phase-1 alias `product-signal`) is sufficient to submit qualitative payloads; Off / Local-only never outbound. Revocation = set `revokedAt` or `task product-signal:consent --revoke` + optionally `enabled: false`.

**Why:** Enable is ops/project posture; consent is personal and must not be committed into PROJECT-DEFINITION. Matches issue + #2603 consent-tier principle without inventing a second taxonomy.

**Rejected:** Consent-only (no enable); enable-only; storing consent inside committed PROJECT-DEFINITION; ambient consent prompt when disabled.

### D3. No ambient nag when off

**Decided:** When `enabled` is false, skills/session rituals MUST NOT prompt for consent or mention product-signal as required UX. Triggers are explicit (`product check-in`, `pulse`, skill entry) or ops-documented partner onboarding — never session:start spam for public consumers.

### D17. First-time consent UX (interactive only)

**Decided (2026-07-21):** When `productSignal.enabled` is true, session is **interactive** (not D16 headless), and consent is missing/revoked, the skill MUST ask before any outbound submit.

**Canonical prompt (Phase 1 copy — lock wording intent; minor grammar polish OK at implement):**

> May we collect usage metrics and related session signal from this install to improve Directive? This can include a short check-in plus minimized local summaries (value/health and related ledgers). Nothing is sent while this path is off or without your consent.
>
> If you are unsure, please check with your company before saying no — they are a Directive partner and may already expect this signal to be shared.
>
> Reply **yes** to consent, or **no** to decline.

**Behavior:**
- **yes** → write consent file (`grantedAt`, `consentVersion`, tier); continue interview/submit.
- **no** → do not write grant; soft-skip submit this session; do not badger every turn — ? MAY remind on a later explicit skill entry, not ambient session:start.
- **Revoke:** `task product-signal:consent --revoke` and/or `productSignal.enabled: false` (either is sufficient to stop outbound).
- Headless: D16 — never show this prompt; fail open.
- Public installs with `enabled: false`: D3 — never show this prompt.

**Why the partner line:** Phase 1 enablement is for partner/trial installs; a bare “no” may conflict with company expectation. Keep the ask optional and human-gated; do not auto-grant.

**Rejected:** Auto-consent because partner; ambient nag when disabled; legalistic multi-page consent; omitting the “check with your company” guidance for Phase 1 partner path.

### D4. Surfaces in Phase 1 MVP

**Decided:**
| Surface | Phase 1 | Behavior |
|---------|---------|----------|
| **Pulse** | YES | Frequent; agent-led ≤3 human answers + optional NPS; append comment (or create standing issue then comment) |
| **Portrait** | YES | Once/upsert; agent-led baseline; edit standing issue body in place |
| **Gap/bug private** | YES (thin) | See D19 — comment on standing **pulse** thread; no extra disclosure beyond enable+consent |

Public gap path remains #1709 with hard confirm on promote.

**Rejected:** Shipping separate `surface:gap` issues as Phase 1 MVP; replacing `feedback:file` for public gaps.

### D5. SubmitAdapter seam (transport-pluggable)

**Decided:** Core module owns interview orchestration helpers + payload assembly + validation. Transport is `SubmitAdapter`:

```ts
interface SubmitAdapter {
  readonly id: string; // "github-private-sink" | "http-challenge" (Phase 2)
  submit(payload: ProductSignalPayload): Promise<SubmitResult>;
}
```

Phase 1 ships `GitHubPrivateSinkAdapter` only. Skill and CLI call the adapter registry; #2697 adds HTTP adapter without rewriting interview/consent/payload.

**Rejected:** Hard-wiring `gh issue create` inside the skill with no seam.

### D6. Sink targeting

**Decided (amended 2026-07-21 — bake-in name):**
- **Canonical sink repo (baked-in default):** `deftai/product-signal` (private).
- Policy field `plan.policy.productSignal.sinkRepo` remains overridable; when unset, adapters/CLI use the baked-in default.
- **Repo creation is part of the #2693 build:** implementation includes an agent/ops step that creates `deftai/product-signal` as **private** under the `deftai` org (via `gh repo create` or equivalent), with a minimal README describing purpose + label expectations — not a manual afterthought.
- Invites / collaborator ACL remain ops (outside public partner roster docs).
- Writes use operator `gh` auth (collaborator model) for v1. 401/403/404 → soft-skip with clear one-liner; never hard-fail workflows.
- Bot-token filing is Deferred (D-bot).

**Why this name:** Matches `productSignal` policy/skill naming; distinct from public `deftai/directive` and from future warehouse/dashboard hosts; no partner branding in the public name.

**Rejected:** Filing pulses to public `deftai/directive` by default; leaving sink name unset until ops invents one; inventing partner roster in-tree; names that imply metrics warehouse (`…-insights-db`, etc.).

### D7. Payload contract (shared with #2603 / #2697)

**Decided:** Versioned payload `schemaVersion: 1`:

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "surface": "pulse" | "portrait",
  "installId": "...",
  "actorName": "...",
  "actorNameSource": "user-md" | "gh-login" | "unnamed",
  "directiveVersion": "...",
  "os": "...", "osVersion": "...",
  "shell": "...",
  "harness": "cursor" | "cli" | "codex" | "opencode" | "other",
  "harnessVersion": "...",
  "consentTier": "...", "consentSource": "user" | "org-policy" | "typed-override", "consentVersion": "...",
  "human": { "nps": 0-10 | null, "answers": [{"q":"...","a":"..."}], "freeText": "..." | null },
  "agentNotes": "..." | null,
  "localSignalSummary": null | {
    "schemaVersion": 1,
    "window": "30d",
    "valueFeedback": { "enabled": true|false, "total": 0, "byClass": { "value": 0, "bypass": 0, "adoption": 0, "friction": 0 }, "topEvents": [{"name": "...", "count": 0}] },
    "evalHealth": { "score": 0-100 | null, "contradictionCount": 0 | null, "collectedAt": "ISO" | null },
    "helpedHealth": { "helpedCount": 0 | null, "healthEntryCount": 0 | null, "window": "30d" }
  },
  "skillsSummary": null | { "schemaVersion": 1, "top": [{"skill": "...", "useCount": 0, "viewCount": 0, "lastUsed": "ISO" | null}], "skillCount": 0 },
  "collectedAt": "ISO-8601"
}
```

Client-side validation before submit: schema, max body size, secret-hygiene scan (token-shaped strings / `.env` dumps). Minimization: no chat transcripts, no file paths, no full USER.md, no issue bodies, **no raw `events.jsonl` / full health log dumps**.

Reuse/extract install-context collectors so #2603 batch upload and #2697 HTTP path share one schema module.

**Existing local ledgers (Phase 1 — minimized attach):** Pulse/Portrait **MUST** attempt to assemble `localSignalSummary` from the live local systems when gates allow (see D15): `#1709` attribution / `value:show` shape, `#1703` `eval:health`, `#2545` helped/health user-data logs. Missing/disabled/empty ledgers → null sub-objects, not hard-fail.

**#829 skill-usage sidecar (do-not-lose):** Phase 1 ships `skillsSummary` as an **optional, minimized** field. Populate **only when** a local skill-telemetry sidecar already exists (read-only attach); otherwise omit/null. Implementing the sidecar + emit path (**#829**) is **not** a Phase 1 blocker and must not gate Pulse/Portrait — but it is an explicit follow-on in this Insights group so the older issue does not evaporate. Full heatmap-as-primary-signal belongs with Insights batch / after #829 lands (see D14 / Deferred `D-skills-telemetry`).

### D8. Dedup / standing threads (Phase 1 inbox, not warehouse)

**Decided (amended 2026-07-21 — delimit by name):**
- **Phase 1 sink shape:** standing GitHub issues in `deftai/product-signal` are an **operator-readable inbox**, not the long-term analytics warehouse (#2603 owns batch/warehouse/dashboard).
- **Thread key:** `(installId, actorName)` — delimit portrait/pulse standing issues by **name**, not install alone (two people / identities on one machine must not share a thread).
- **`actorName` resolution (first hit wins):**
  1. USER.md addressing-name (`Name` / Personal section) when present and non-blank after trim
  2. Else authenticated `gh` login (best-effort)
  3. Else literal `unnamed`
- Normalize for markers/search: trim, collapse whitespace, case-fold for match keys; keep display form in issue body.
- **Portrait:** one standing issue per `(installId, actorName)` (labels `surface:portrait` + markers in body); upsert body.
- **Pulse:** append dated comments on a standing pulse issue for the same key (label `surface:pulse`); create if missing.
- Payload carries `actorName` + `actorNameSource` (`user-md` | `gh-login` | `unnamed`) for ops readability.
- Labels (sink repo): see D20 — **bootstrap at repo create**, not lazy-create.
- `SubmitAdapter` may later target HTTP/warehouse (#2697 / epic) without rewriting interview/consent/payload assembly.

**Rejected:** installId-only threads; one global mega-issue; new GitHub issue per pulse (spam); treating GitHub issues as the metrics warehouse / aggregate SoT; title-only dedup like framework-gap; requiring USER.md to be populated before a pulse can file.

### D9. Agent skill UX

**Decided:** Skill `deft-directive-product-signal`:
- Triggers: `product check-in`, `product pulse`, `partner feedback`, `product signal`
- Phases: gate (enabled+consent) → interview (agent-driven, ≤3 questions) → assemble payload → validate → adapter.submit → report URL or soft-skip reason
- Conversational with humans; deterministic gates for enable/consent/confirm-on-public-promote
- Always-pin: **no** (not process-critical false-negative gate); discoverable via Skills Index

Human cost target: ≤30s and ≤3 answers beyond first-time consent.

### D10. CLI verbs (Phase 1)

**Decided:**
- `task product-signal:status` — enabled? consented? sinkRepo? last submit?
- `task product-signal:enable -- --confirm` — typed policy enable + capability-cost disclosure
- `task product-signal:consent -- --grant|--revoke` — write consent file
- `task product-signal:submit -- --surface pulse|portrait [--dry-run] [--json]` — non-skill path for tests/ops; still requires gates

Mirror `policy:show --field=productSignal` registration like valueFeedback.

### D11. Soft-skip matrix

| Condition | Behavior |
|-----------|----------|
| enabled false | silent no-op / "disabled" one-liner; no consent prompt |
| enabled, no consent | prompt once on explicit skill entry; refuse submit until grant |
| enabled+consent, network off / DEFT_NO_NETWORK | soft-skip |
| enabled+consent, 401/403/404 / unreachable sink | soft-skip with ACL/network hint — **fail open** (D18); never block caller |
| validation fail | refuse submit; show reason; no partial write |
| headless / non-interactive (D16) | fail open — soft-skip; never block caller; no consent/interview prompts |

### D18. Sink unreachable — fail open, retry next session (not forever)

**Decided (2026-07-21):** If `deftai/product-signal` (or configured `sinkRepo`) cannot be reached — DNS/network error, timeout, GitHub 5xx, 401/403/404, missing repo — product-signal **and** any dependent attach paths that require the sink (**fail open**):

- ⊗ Do not fail the operator session, story work, value/health local ledgers, or headless automation because the sink is down.
- ⊗ Do **not** persist a permanent “sink dead / never retry” bit that blocks future sessions.
- ! Soft-skip this attempt with structured outcome (`sink-unreachable` | `sink-unauthorized` | …); local ledgers (#1709 / #1703 / #2545) keep working as today.
- ! **New sessions MAY retry** — absence of success is not a sticky denylist. Optional short in-session debounce (e.g. don’t hammer every tool call in one session) is allowed; cross-session sticky forever-fail is forbidden.
- ! Consent + enable state are unchanged by a failed reachability probe (unreachable ≠ revoked).

**Why:** Partners and headless runs must not wedge on a private repo outage; ops may create/fix ACL later and the next interactive or headless-eligible session should try again.

**Rejected:** Fail-closed on sink errors; permanent circuit-breaker without expiry that never retries; clearing consent because submit failed.

### D19. Private gap handoff — pulse comment; public still confirmation-gated

**Decided (2026-07-21):**
- **Private:** When a check-in surfaces a bug/gap, Phase 1 records it as a **dated comment on the standing pulse issue** for `(installId, actorName)` (same thread as pulses). No second disclosure prompt beyond enable+consent (D2/D17). Marker prefix e.g. `Gap:` for ops scanability.
- **Public promote:** Filing/escalating to public `deftai/directive` via `feedback:file` / deft-directive-feedback remains **hard confirmation-gated** (#1709 / epic principle 6). Agent may quote the private pulse comment into the draft.
- **Not Phase 1:** separate `surface:gap` standing issues (revisit if gap volume / triage pain warrants).

**Why:** Private inbox under partner ACL does not need a second “are you sure?”; public issues do.

**Rejected:** Extra disclosure for private gap notes; auto-filing public framework-gap issues from pulses; Phase 1 dedicated gap issues per actor.

### D20. Sink label bootstrap at repo create

**Decided (2026-07-21):** When the #2693 build creates private `deftai/product-signal`, it **MUST bootstrap** the fixed label set so ops filters work immediately. ⊗ Rely on lazy-create on first issue as the primary path.

**Phase 1 bootstrap set (minimum):**
- `surface:pulse`, `surface:portrait`
- `nps:promoter` (9–10), `nps:passive` (7–8), `nps:detractor` (0–6), `nps:none` (no score)
- `signal:gap` (optional marker when a pulse thread has Gap: comments — apply/update on the pulse issue when a gap comment is added)

Directive version labels (`directive:<major.minor>`) MAY be created on first use (unbounded set) or bootstrapped for current+N minors — implementation choice; document in README.

Repo README created with the build lists these labels and the standing-thread conventions (D8/D19).

**Rejected:** Lazy-only label creation for the fixed surface/nps set.

### D12. Docs / CHANGELOG

**Decided:** Generic operator docs ("optional product-improvement signal with consent"); no partner roster. CHANGELOG user-facing under Unreleased when implementation lands. Public issue may describe mechanism; payloads stay private.

### D13. Wave boundary vs epic / Phase 2

**In #2693:** D1–D12 + D14–D20 (design lock complete for Phase 1 open questions) + **D8 name-delimited threads** (policy, consent file, payload module including `localSignalSummary` + optional `skillsSummary`, GitHub adapter, skill, CLI, tests, docs).
**Not in #2693 implementation:** warehouse, dashboard, org-mandatory Insights egress, outbox/flush, challenge/nonce HTTP (#2697), bot-token submitter, **building** the skill-usage sidecar emit path (#829), re-implementing #1709/#1703/#2545 ledgers (read/summarize only).

### D14. #829 skill telemetry — schema hook now, emit later (do-not-lose)

**Decided (2026-07-21 amendment):**
- Keep #829 **out of Phase 1 build waves** (sidecar + `skills:track` / host-hook emit stays its own track; also feeds #828 lifecycle).
- **Do not let #829 get lost:** it is an explicit child-adjacent of epic #2603 / this on-ramp group — listed on the umbrella current-shape and referenced from this lock.
- Phase 1 payload reserves optional minimized `skillsSummary` (D7); Phase 1 may ship with the field always null.
- **Populate `skillsSummary` in posts** once #829 (or a thin interim ledger) exists — treat as Phase 2 / Insights enrichment for the *emit* path; schema hook is Phase 1.
- Skill heatmaps as a **primary** Insights dashboard signal remain epic-core Wave 3+.

**Why:** Older open issue (#829) is easy to orphan; the product-signal path is the natural consumer, so the contract must name it even while implementation stays decoupled.

**Rejected:** Blocking #2693 on #829; requiring non-empty skill telemetry in every Pulse/Portrait.

### D15. Existing value / health / helped ledgers — minimized Phase 1 attach

**Decided (2026-07-21):** Phase 1 product-signal posts **include minimized summaries of Directive's existing local ledgers**, not only the interview answers. #2693 is the qualitative on-ramp **and** the first consented carrier for scrubbed local signal into `deftai/product-signal`.

**MUST attach when available (read-only; never fail the pulse if absent):**
1. **`valueFeedback` / attribution (#1709)** — windowed counts from `.deft-cache/events.jsonl` in the `value:show` shape (totals + byClass + small topEvents). Respect local policy: if `valueFeedback.enabled` is false / maintainer dogfood gate blocks, set sub-object null or `{ enabled: false, ...zeros }` — do not invent events.
2. **`evalHealth` (#1703)** — latest `eval:health` score + contradiction count (no full gate dump).
3. **`helpedHealth` (#2545)** — windowed counts from helped/health user-data logs (counts only).

**Payload field:** `localSignalSummary` (D7). Default window `30d` (overridable later; not a Phase 1 bikeshed).

**MUST NOT:** dump raw `events.jsonl`, full health JSONL, chat, paths, or USER.md into the sink issue.

**Relationship to #2603:** This is a **minimized inbox attach** for partner/ops readability. Epic batch/warehouse/dashboard remains the aggregate analytics path and may reuse the same summarizer modules. ⊗ Treat standing GitHub issues as the warehouse SoT.

**Rejected:** Omitting local ledgers from Phase 1 (interview-only); attaching raw ledgers; requiring valueFeedback to be ON before a pulse can send (soft-null instead).

### D16. Headless / non-interactive — fail open

**Decided (2026-07-21):** Headless Directive runs (CI agents, cloud agents, scheduled/`task` automation, swarm workers, any non-interactive session) **MUST fail open** on the product-signal path.

- ⊗ Block story work, swarm dispatch, CI, or session:start because product-signal is disabled, unconsented, sink ACL-denied, network-off, or validation-soft-failed.
- ! Soft-skip with a structured outcome (`disabled` | `no-consent` | `no-network` | `sink-unauthorized` | `validation` | `non-interactive`) and continue the caller.
- ! **No interactive consent / interview prompts** in headless — if consent is missing or an interview would be required, skip send (fail open). Do not hang waiting for a human.
- ? Headless **MAY** still submit when enable+consent already recorded and payload can be assembled without prompts (e.g. portrait refresh / ledger-only attach) — optional; default skip is acceptable if detection is ambiguous.
- Detection: non-TTY / `DEFT_HEADLESS=1` / known cloud-agent / CI env markers (exact detector list is implementation detail; bias toward treating unknown automation as headless).

**Why:** Headless Directive is already in production use; a consent nag or hard error would regress automation. Product signal is optional enrichment.

**Rejected:** Fail-closed headless; prompting in CI; requiring USER.md name before headless can proceed.
narratives.SurfacedRisks:
- **Consent taxonomy drift:** #2603 defines Off/Local/Insights-anonymous/Insights-linked; Phase 1 only needs a grant that permits qualitative outbound. Mitigate by storing `consentVersion` + mapping table in the consent module shared with epic.
- **Sink ACL footgun:** collaborators with `gh` auth can write; unauthorized soft-skip must not look like success. Mitigate with explicit outcome enum in CLI/skill.
- **Standing-issue race:** two agents upserting portrait concurrently. Mitigate with installId marker + search-before-create; accept last-write-wins for v1.
- **Secret leakage in free text:** human paste. Mitigate with client secret-hygiene scan + size cap; agent instructs "no secrets/paths".
- **Policy enable committed to git:** partners might commit `enabled: true` into shared PROJECT-DEFINITION. Acceptable for private partner repos; public templates must keep default false.
- **#829 orphan risk:** older skill-telemetry issue can stall forever if only mentioned verbally. Mitigate via D14 + umbrella current-shape listing + payload schema hook.
- **Ledger over-attach:** ops might treat inbox summaries as warehouse truth. Mitigate via D8/D15 wording + docs: minimized attach ≠ Insights batch.
- **Blank USER.md collision:** many `unnamed` actors on one installId share a thread. Acceptable Phase 1; gh-login fallback reduces it; document that setting USER.md name splits threads.
- **Headless false-negative:** interactive session mis-detected as headless skips a wanted pulse. Bias documented; operator can re-run skill interactively.
narratives.DeferredDecisions:
### Ops-owned (not blocked on public design)
- **Sink repo name** — LOCKED: `deftai/product-signal` (D6); creation is part of #2693 build. Invites/ACL stay ops/Slack.
- **Label bootstrap on sink** — LOCKED (D20): bootstrap fixed surface/nps set at repo create.
- **Issue-vs-warehouse shape for standing threads** — LOCKED (D8): standing issues = Phase 1 operator inbox; warehouse = #2603.

### Later enhancements (out of Phase 1)
- **D-bot:** GitHub App / bot token so humans need no sink UI access.
- **D-org-mandate:** `deftai` org-mandatory Insights egress (#2603 only).
- **D-http:** challenge/nonce adapter (#2697).
- **D-gap-private-full:** separate `surface:gap` issues / richer private triage if pulse-thread comments prove too noisy (D19 Phase 1 = pulse comments).
- **D-anonymous-tier:** Insights-anonymous qualitative path (Phase 1 uses linked/collaborator model).
- **D-skills-telemetry (#829):** implement local skill-usage sidecar + emit (view/use/patch); then fill `skillsSummary` on product-signal posts / Insights batch. Do-not-lose under epic #2603 — schedule after or parallel to #2693 Wave A–C, before treating skill heatmaps as primary Insights signal. Related: #828 lifecycle, #2437/#2438 host hooks for reliable view/use.
narratives.ImplementationWaves:
### Wave A — foundations (ship first)
1. `plan.policy.productSignal` typed policy + `policy:show` / enable verb + capability-cost disclosure
2. Consent file read/write + revoke (`product-signal:consent`)
3. Shared install-context + ProductSignalPayload schema/validate module
4. `localSignalSummary` summarizers (read-only) over #1709 events.jsonl / `value:show` shape, #1703 eval:health, #2545 helped/health logs — null-safe

### Wave B — transport
4. `SubmitAdapter` interface + `GitHubPrivateSinkAdapter` (standing issue create/upsert/comment)
5. Soft-skip outcome matrix + tests (symlink/ACL/network)

### Wave C — agent UX
6. Skill `deft-directive-product-signal` + Skills Index entry
7. `product-signal:status` / `submit` verbs
8. Operator docs + CHANGELOG

Suggested PR slices: A alone; B alone; C alone — or A+B then C.
